## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the incomplete feature or defect and the behavior this change delivers.

## Scope and contracts

List the affected extension, runtime, service, protobuf, model artifact, or deployment paths. Explain any configuration, migration, privacy, or compatibility changes.

## Validation

Record the tested commit and actual check results. Include focused tests and the Service stack CI link; distinguish failed or unrun checks from passing checks.

- [ ] Browser extension tests and Chromium/Firefox builds, when affected
- [ ] Runtime, supervisor, shared Python, and service tests, when affected
- [ ] Model service race tests and artifact/update checks, when affected
- [ ] Production/development stack and TLS smoke checks, when affected
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the final implementation

## Remaining limitations

Describe unresolved behavior, deployment prerequisites, and material checks that could not run. Write “None” when there are none.

## Review and merge

- [ ] Required CI passes for the revision to be merged
- [ ] At least one System Architect (SA) approval is recorded
- [ ] Additional repository reviews and unresolved review threads are addressed
- [ ] The merger is not the PR author, as required by `docs/git-usage.md`
